title: Elevated plus maze, mouse (arms 30 x 5 cm)
question: How long does the mouse spend in each open arm, each closed arm and the centre, how often does it enter each arm, and how far does it travel?

refused.request: total open-arm time and percent time in the open arms as single numbers
refused.reason: Kappa's zones can't be joined into one zone yet, so each arm is reported on its own; the open-arm total is the sum of the two arm values

refused.request: head dips over the edge of the open arms
refused.reason: the segmenter tracks the whole body and there is no head-dip detector

notes: The maze is a cross, but Kappa's arena is a rectangle, so the arena here is the 65 x 65 cm square that bounds the cross (two 30 cm arms either side of a 5 x 5 cm centre). Every zone is a rect_cm rectangle in that square's centimetres, origin at its top-left, with the open arms running left-right and the closed arms top-bottom in the image; swap the zone rectangles if your camera sees the maze turned by 90 degrees. The corners of the bounding square are not points on the maze: mark them where the outer edges of the arm ends meet when extended. Until they are located arena.corners_px is null and the protocol can't be confirmed. Arm entries are judged by the body centre, the usual automated convention; the manual 'all four paws' rule counts fewer entries. Sizes are a common mouse maze; rat mazes are about 50 x 10 cm per arm.
